title: Cross-Brand Promotional Depth Conflict with Emoji Approval
question: Is Brand A's SUMMER40 promotion (40% off current-season mainline) compliant with Atlas pricing governance?

contributor.name: Laura Svensson
contributor.title: Pricing Strategy Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: MAP enforcement, promotional pricing governance, wholesale vs DTC price parity, channel conflict resolution

choices: No — the CMO's approval was specifically scoped to 'last-season/end-of-life SKUs only' and SUMMER40 applies to current-season mainline; the approval does not cover this promotion
Yes — the CMO gave explicit approval via the checkmark emoji in the #brand-leads Slack thread; this constitutes written approval per Section 7.2
Partially compliant — the CMO approval covers the depth (40%) but the cross-brand conflict with Brand B creates a separate violation under Section 7.4 that requires retroactive review
No — regardless of CMO approval, the promotion was not submitted 30 days in advance per Section 7.4, making it procedurally non-compliant even if substantively authorized
